blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — To secure the hundreds of thousands expected to pour into congested graveyards and sprawling memorial parks this week, Northern Mindanao’s police force will deploy over 7,200 officers and volunteers starting Saturday, October 31. The Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) will go on full alert for the traditional observance of All Saints’ and All Souls’ Days, blanketing the region with a mix of regular officers and community peacekeepers to secure the public until November 2. The region-wide deployment consists of 4,044 regular police officers, 1,059 personnel from allied law enforcement units, and 2,103 force multipliers, including barangay peacekeepers […]...
